name: Flashcards
description: Decks you can share, with a schedule that stays yours. Cards live in the space, so a study group builds one deck together and everybody drills the same material — but what you have learned is counted per person, so your intervals never move because a classmate answered well. Reviewing uses SM-2, the spaced-repetition schedule Anki is built on: rate a card and it comes back tomorrow, in six days, or in a month, depending on how well you have been doing with it. Each answer shows what it will cost you, so choosing is a decision rather than a guess. Space editors write the cards; anyone in the space can study them. Decks, cards and each person's progress live in encrypted LocalTables scoped to the placement.
